Observed constraints & initial diagnostics:
- Region: account default set to us-east-1; majority of customer base is NA but 20% EU traffic routed through CloudFront; cross-region latency evident. Recommend testing eu-west-1 route.
- Timeouts: default client-side timeout was 10s but some SDK examples use 5s — clients saw truncated responses when spikes hit.
- Prompt size: large context (1.5k-2k tokens) increases model compute; observed cost vs latency tradeoff.
- Streaming: they currently use non-streaming generation for UI simplicity; streaming could improve perceived latency for users.
- Caching: no prefix caching configured; many queries share product metadata prefixes.

Perf tuning recommendations given (shared during call / follow-up):
- Region choice: suggest set region to eu-west-1 for EU-heavy sessions; configure smart routing via app edge to pick nearest Redwood region.
- Timeout settings: client timeout 30s for initial rollout; set connection keepalive and retry logic (exponential backoff with jitter).
- Prompt guidance: trim convo context to essential messages (aim for <800 tokens typical); move product catalog to embeddings/secondary lookup rather than embedding everything inline.
- Use streaming: enable streaming for chat UX so first tokens render faster — reduces perceived latency even if total generation time similar.
- Enable prefix/KV cache for repeated product intro text.
- Token limits: advise model variant with faster kernels (quantized where acceptable) for high-throughput flows.

- POC target: 10k active monthly users -> estimate 300-400 reqs/min peak.
- Current test: ~2k tokens per request; goal to reduce to ~700-800 tokens avg to cut p95 by ~30-45% (approx).
